# `openai_chat_completions_to_anthropic`

Translates OpenAI Chat Completions requests only when the selected `ExternalModel` candidate uses Anthropic Messages; OpenAI candidates pass through with their configured path and model.

## Configuration Notes

The trusted profile is emitted by `intelligent_route`, never inferred from a request header or model name. The selected Secret is injected later by `credential_inject`.

For Anthropic candidates, non-streaming JSON response chunks are retained in bounded request-local state until they can be translated. The separate SSE filter converts event chunks incrementally, and OpenAI-compatible response chunks remain unchanged.

Anthropic translation runs only when the filter's `api_translation_enabled` setting is true, as derived from the tenant's API translation permission.

Only Chat Completions fields represented by Anthropic Messages are accepted. Unsupported fields and modalities fail with a 400 response.

## Configuration

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|---------|-------------|
| `api_translation_enabled` | bool | yes | Permission projected from the authoritative `MaaS` tenant setting. Anthropic candidates fail closed when this is false. |
| `max_body_bytes` | integer | yes | Maximum complete JSON body retained for one request or response. |
